meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning skill. Self-orchestrates 5 hostile category members (unspecified-low, unspecified-high, deep, ultrabrain, artistry) via team-mode for ruthless cross-critique debate, distills only the defensible insights, then MANDATORILY hands the distilled insight bundle to the `plan` agent for executable plan formalization. Use when planning needs maximum rigor and surfacing of weak assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering. Triggers: 'hyperplan', 'hpp', '/hyperplan', 'adversarial plan', 'hostile planning', 'cross-critique plan', '하이퍼플랜', '적대적 계획', '교차 비평'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 召集多个互相对抗的AI反复挑刺,只留下站得住的判断,再整理成可执行方案。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果关键决策容不得想当然,想先被自己的假设挑一遍刺。
copy.tagline_en: Stress-test a plan with adversarial AI critics, then turn the survivors into steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a decision is too important to get wrong and you want your assumptions attacked first

howto.what: 加载后 Claude 会先喊“HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!”,组建 5 名互相敌对的成员做交叉批判辩论,只保留经得起攻击的洞察,再交给 plan agent 形成可执行计划。
howto.when: 当你提到 “hyperplan”、“hpp”、“adversarial plan” 等触发词,或需要在规划中暴露弱假设、盲点、过度设计时触发。

say.text: 用 hyperplan 帮我规划这次数据库迁移
say.note: 先开启 HYPERPLAN 模式并组建 5 人辩论队

say.text: hyperplan:批判这个重构方案里的过度设计
say.note: 成员互相攻击,只留站得住脚的洞察

say.text: /hyperplan 规划支付流程改造,重点找盲点
say.note: 最后由 plan agent 输出可执行计划

howto.what_en: After loading, Claude announces “HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!”, spawns 5 mutually hostile members for cross-critique debate, keeps only defensible insights, then hands them to the plan agent for an executable plan.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say “hyperplan”, “hpp”, “adversarial plan”, or when a plan needs weak assumptions, blind spots and over-engineering surfaced.

say_en.text: Use hyperplan to plan this database migration.
say_en.note: It enables HYPERPLAN mode and spawns 5 debaters.

say_en.text: hyperplan: attack the over-engineering in this refactor plan
say_en.note: Members critique each other; only defensible insights survive.

say_en.text: /hyperplan plan the payment flow rework, hunt for blind spots
say_en.note: The plan agent then produces an executable plan.
